context: A rural village in Iwate. A young visitor from Tokyo (Ren) has stopped at Tatsuya's small farm shop to ask directions to the local shrine.
purpose: kind rural encounter — quiet help with a side of unsolicited local pride

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: すみません、ちょっとお尋ねしてもいいですか？
lines.en: Excuse me — may I ask you something?
lines.style: Polite, slightly out of breath. Tokyo formality landing in a rural shop.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.style: Slow, weathered voice. Three unhurried words. Looks up from what he's doing only after the first one.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: この近くの神社、少し迷ってしまって…
lines.en: The shrine around here — I've gotten a little lost…
lines.style: A small embarrassed half-laugh. Holds up the phone with a faded map on it.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: ああ、神社な。歩いて、十分くらい。
lines.en: Ah, the shrine. About ten minutes on foot.
lines.style: Sentences arrive in pieces with comfortable air between them. The pace of someone who never rushes.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: この道、まっすぐ。途中で、大きい木があるから、そこを右。
lines.en: This road, straight on. There's a big tree along the way — turn right there.
lines.style: Hand gestures in the voice. Locally tested directions. Each instruction comes with a small pause.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 大丈夫です、わかりました。本当に、ありがとうございます。
lines.en: Got it, thank you. Really, thank you.
lines.style: A small bow inside the voice. The second 「ありがとう」 is the genuine one.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: いいや。…ここの神社、この辺で一番、静かでいいとこだよ。
lines.en: It's nothing. …The shrine here — quietest, best spot around.
lines.style: A small unbidden gift. Pride that doesn't announce itself. JP and EN: same quiet conviction.
